name: vacation-management
description: Vacation management app: Vue 3 frontend + Node.js (CommonEventFramework) API + PostgreSQL

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix frontend
